purpose: Implementation freeze required by the protocol implementation_rule: the TEST evaluation script, smoke-tested on VALIDATION rows only, is hashed here before it reads a TEST row.

smoke_test.split: RepE-LM VALIDATION (1,780 rows); 6 SAEs (old TopK s42, R2 TopK s42 at L1/8/11)
smoke_test.result: reproduces the committed validation ladder: max |diff| <= 1e-4 on pair_dir_cosine, persona refit/frozen gaps, held-out gaps, T_rec/T_full, T_full; live activations vs cache <= 1.8e-4; M4 rows identical to S24.build_rows

checkpoints: 81 sources (L1 23, L8 29, L11 29); 78 in-house hashes equal docs/checkpoint_registry.csv; all 81 equal the validation ladder hashes; listed in checkpoint_hashes.csv
clarifications: Multiplicity: the protocol text says 12 HT1-HT3 cells, but its own lists give 13 (HT1 2 + HT2 9 + HT3 2). Holm is applied over all 13 (more conservative). A cell is CONFIRMED only if the R2 rule classes it IMPROVEMENT on TEST (all 9 seed pairs better and Welch 95% CI excludes 0) AND its Welch two-sided p, Holm-adjusted over the 13 cells, is < 0.05. A hypothesis is CONFIRMED only if every one of its cells is confirmed.
Metrics are the ladder definitions computed by unchanged imported code; no PCA reference is computed on TEST (not part of HT1-HT4).

Near-duplicate sensitivity: no same-label near-duplicates remain in the TEST statements; the 12 opposite-label counterfactual edits carry no persona-label information (both personas per statement) and are not excluded.

HT4 neutral floor: persona probe (fit on TRAIN T1-T4 original activations) AUROC on N1/N2 and N3/N4 TEST rows must be <= 0.55; positive control: M3/M4 T_full > 0 with 95% CI low > 0 at each site; K7: persona KL(H||U) > synonym KL(H||Hp).
All cells, comparisons and controls are reported whatever the outcome; TEST rows are read once.
